title: G-NAC: Graph Neural Automata Clustering via Emergent Domain Formation
abstract: arXiv:2609.24823v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We introduce Graph Neural Automata Clustering (G-NAC), an unsupervised clustering method in which observations interact as cells on a fixed neighborhood graph. A shared recurrent graph-neural cellular rule evolves latent domain states through local interactions, which are converted into a rank-based spectral affinity for partitioning. Across 73 clustering tasks from 57 benchmark datasets, G-NAC achieved a mean adjusted Rand index (ARI) of 0.7951, comparable to Genie at 0.7941 and higher than the other evaluated baselines. Empirical training time and GPU memory scaled approximately linearly from 5,000 to 100,000 nodes. Learned transition rules also transferred from smaller source graphs to independent 100,000-node samples generated under matched conditions. These results demonstrate a recurrent graph-clustering formulation while identifying dependencies on graph quality, readout design, and source-target similarity.

translated_title: G-NAC：通过涌现域形成实现图神经自动机聚类
translated_abstract: 我们提出了图神经自动机聚类（G-NAC），这是一种无监督聚类方法，其中观测值作为固定邻域图上的细胞进行交互。一个共享的循环图神经细胞规则通过局部交互演化潜在域状态，这些状态随后被转换为基于秩的谱亲和度用于划分。在来自57个基准数据集的73个聚类任务中，G-NAC取得了0.7951的平均调整兰德指数（ARI），与Genie的0.7941相当，并高于其他被评估的基线方法。从5,000到100,000个节点，实际训练时间和GPU内存近似线性扩展。学习到的转换规则还能从较小的源图迁移到在匹配条件下生成的独立的100,000节点样本。这些结果展示了一种循环图聚类框架，同时指出了其对图质量、读出设计和源-目标相似性的依赖。
tldr: G-NAC提出了一种无监督图聚类新方法，通过图神经细胞自动机的局部交互涌现出域结构，在73个聚类任务上达到与最优基线相当的聚类性能，且训练时间和内存随节点数近似线性扩展，学习到的规则还可跨图迁移。
en_tdlr: G-NAC introduces an unsupervised graph clustering method where a recurrent graph-neural cellular rule evolves latent domain states through local interactions, achieving clustering performance comparable to state-of-the-art baselines with near-linear scaling and transferable learned rules.
